summary: The native-libraries group is 1371 rows across five partitions: system_a 787, vendor_a 368, system_ext_a 169, odm_a 27 and product_a 20. It contains 1361 regular files and 10 symlinks. The regular files are 1351 ELF shared objects (854 ELF64 AArch64, 497 ELF32 ARM, all ET_DYN) and 10 LLVM bitcode files (libclc built-in libraries under system/lib and system/lib64). The symlinks are 8 bionic links (libc, libdl, libdl_android, libm in system/lib and system/lib64) that point into /apex/com.android.runtime, which is not in the mount, plus odm_a and vendor_a lib/modules links to the dlkm partitions. system_a holds the AOSP platform and NDK-public libraries plus HIDL/AIDL interface libraries and Rust dylibs. vendor_a holds Qualcomm HIDL/AIDL clients, HAL modules (lib/hw, lib64/hw), FastRPC, audio (AGM/PAL) and camera/display libraries. system_ext_a, product_a and odm_a hold device-specific libraries (Oculus/Meta telemetry, tracking, XR loader, maintenance boot, Vulkan layers). The configuration that governs the group is system/etc/public.libraries.txt (29 entries) and vendor/etc/public.libraries.txt (8 entries), plus SELinux labels in plat_file_contexts line 121 and vendor_file_contexts lines 142-153, 196. The role table is at roles.tsv with 1371 rows: 453 verified, 857 inferred, 61 unverified. In the evidence, <image>/mnt means <image>/mnt.
